name: guildmaster
description: MA triage: resolve ambiguous phrases, classify situation, assemble SA prompt, dispatch. MA orchestration — interpret each group of user messages into intents, track active objectives in a table, classify each into a fulfillment type (quest or direct_action), assemble and dispatch SA prompts, and evaluate output against closing criteria. Also runs the evolution loops (EL full-run scoring, SE step-checkpoint hardening) that validate substrate changes via fresh-agent dispatch. Use when acting as the MA orchestrator over user requests or running an EL/SE evolution run.
author: GuildOS
